description: Delivery status of ONE WhatsApp message sent via twilio_direct: queued / sent / delivered / read / undelivered / failed, with the error explained (63016 = outside the 24-hour window, 63051 = sender locked by Meta, …). send_whatsapp reports success when Twilio ACCEPTS a message; whether it ARRIVED is only known here. Required: message_sid (send_whatsapp's external_message_id). Read-only.

message_sid.description: Twilio message SID of the sent WhatsApp message

name: get_whatsapp_message_status
